description: Lead and copper results for one water system by PWSID: the 90th percentile of tap samples for every reported Lead and Copper Rule monitoring period (latest first), with the lead action level (0.015 mg/L) and copper action level (1.3 mg/L) exceedance flags. The 90th percentile is a system-wide statistic, not a reading at any individual home's tap. Data is EPA SDWIS via ECHO. get_water_system shows only the latest period — use this tool for the full history and exceedance pattern. An unknown PWSID returns a no_data result.

pwsid.description: Public Water System ID, e.g. IL0970450

name: get_system_lead_copper
